# Japan With Love

> > Japan With Love is an authenticated ecommerce store bringing authentic Japanese beauty, skincare, cosmetics, and wellness products from premium brands like Shiseido, Biore, Rohto, and &honey to global customers.

Japan With Love specializes in curated Japanese cosmetics, skincare, and beauty products sourced directly from trusted Japanese brands. The store emphasizes authenticity, offering everything from daily skincare essentials to anti-aging treatments, with regular flash sales and promotions.

## Skincare Collections

- [Skin Care](https://japanwithlovestore.com/collections/skin-care): Japanese skincare collection featuring cleansers, toners, serums from Biore, HadaLabo, Rohto.
- [Wrinkle & Aging Care](https://japanwithlovestore.com/collections/wrinkle-aging-care): Anti-aging skincare products including serums and creams from Sana, Rohto, Hada Labo.
- [Face & Eye Cream](https://japanwithlovestore.com/collections/japanese-moisturizer-cream-products): Japanese face and eye creams from Meishoku, Sana, Hada Labo, Curél moisturizers.
- [Lotion & Toner](https://japanwithlovestore.com/collections/lotion): Japanese toners and lotions from Rohto, HadaLabo, Hatomugi for hydrating skincare.
- [Serum](https://japanwithlovestore.com/collections/serum): Japanese serums including Rohto Melano CC, SK-II for brightening and anti-aging treatment.
- [Facial Cleansing Items](https://japanwithlovestore.com/collections/facial-cleansing-items): Facial cleansing collection from Shiseido, Kosé, Kanebo, Hada Labo, Kumano brands.
- [Makeup Remover](https://japanwithlovestore.com/collections/makeup-remover): Makeup remover products from Biore, Muji, Heroine Make, Kiss Me for cleansing routines.

## Specialized Beauty Products

- [Masks & Peels](https://japanwithlovestore.com/collections/japanese-face-mask): Japanese face mask collection including sheet masks from Ishizawa Lab, Quality 1st, Kosé.
- [Sunscreen](https://japanwithlovestore.com/collections/sunscreens): Japanese sunscreen collection featuring Biore, Skin Aqua, Nivea, Canmake UV protection.
- [Lip Care](https://japanwithlovestore.com/collections/lip-care): Japanese lip care products including UZU, FLOWFUSHI, Nivea, Mentholatum lip treatments.
- [Hair Care](https://japanwithlovestore.com/collections/japanese-haircare-product-best-selling): Japanese haircare collection from &honey, Shiseido, Hatomugi for shampoo and treatments.

- [Home](https://japanwithlovestore.com): Homepage featuring Japanese cosmetics, supplements, foods & beauty products from brands like Shiseido, Biore, &honey.

## Customer Support & Information

- [Contact Us](https://japanwithlovestore.com/pages/contact-us): Contact form for customer inquiries about products and pre-purchase questions via Zendesk.
- [Shipping Alert: Japan Post Suspension](https://japanwithlovestore.com/blogs/blogs/shipping-alert-japan-post-suspended-services-to-the-us): Alert on Japan Post suspension to US and alternative shipping options for customers.
- [USA Shipping Updates & De Minimis Exemption](https://japanwithlovestore.com/blogs/blogs/de-minimis-exemption-to-end): Update on 15% US import duty changes and de minimis exemption ending August 29, 2025.
- [Counterfeit Site Warnings](https://japanwithlovestore.com/blogs/blogs/fake-japan-with-love-websites): Consumer protection guide warning about counterfeit sites and how to verify authentic Japan With Love.
